About Us

From Bharosa to Aashray.

A journey that began during a crisis has grown into a commitment to dignity, opportunity and community support.

01 / About Us

Where it started

In 2020, the COVID-19 lockdown made everyday life difficult for many people. A group of friends in Siliguri came together under the name Bharosa Group to respond with food support.

The effort began with people helping wherever they could. It was built on participation, practical action and concern for those struggling to arrange a meal.

02 / About Us

The Roti Challenge begins

Families who accepted the Roti Challenge prepared rotis for contribution once a week. The organisation’s team collected the rotis from participating homes, brought the food to its work location for packing and then went out to distribute meals.

This simple model gave families a direct way to take part in community care. Their kitchens became part of a shared effort, alongside the volunteers who collected, packed and distributed the food.

Read the Roti Challenge Story

03 / About Us

The journey forward

The community effort that began as Bharosa Group is now carried forward through Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation. Food and clothing distribution, along with health-related work, form part of the foundation’s experience.

Aashray is preparing an upcoming computer training program and plans to develop work across six impact pillars. Each area will grow with the preparation, people and resources it needs.

04 / About Us

Our mission

To support individuals and communities with dignity through relief, wellbeing, learning opportunities and meaningful community participation.

05 / About Us

Our vision

Over the next three to five years, we aim to become a trusted community organisation across North Bengal, building on our Siliguri roots and creating lasting opportunities for people who need support.

06 / About Us

What guides us

Dignity — Support should respect the person receiving it.

Community — People can contribute in different ways, and each contribution matters.

Compassion — We begin by listening and understanding.

Integrity — We describe our work and plans honestly.

Inclusion — We seek to make participation and opportunity more accessible.

Action — Care becomes meaningful when people turn it into practical support.

07 / About Us

The people behind Aashray

Aashray’s journey has been shaped by the people who contributed food, time and effort. As the foundation grows, its leadership and volunteers carry forward that community spirit.
